# go-web-base

> A Copier template, generated from huddle-go v0.1.0, for Go + SvelteKit web projects with Google sign-in and Casbin RBAC. Tracked in Linear (team IMM, project "go-web-base").

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): What a generated project has, how to copy and update one (Copier 9.19.1 via uvx), the questions, the per-project setup checklist, and how the template and its CI work.
- [docs/consuming.md](docs/consuming.md): How projects build on go-web-base - versioned packages for shared code, Copier for glue, updating, enabling features, what belongs where, writing a feature. Target design (epic IMM-2066), with what is available now marked.
- [core/README.md](core/README.md): The `core` Go module, the shared server code (app, server, config, db, redis, logger, logging), the `app.Options` contract that supplies every project-specific value, and how to run its tests with and without Postgres and Redis.
- [copier.yml](copier.yml): The questions, their defaults and validators, the derived values, and the `[[ ]]` Jinja delimiters.
- [.woodpecker.yml](.woodpecker.yml): Template CI - renders a sample project, sweeps it for `huddle`, and runs its Go and UI checks with the service tests skipped; also a `core` step that tests the core module against real Postgres and Redis services.
- [template/llms.txt.jinja](template/llms.txt.jinja): The doc index each generated project starts with.
